name: LUNAR-Q
source:
A self-proclaimed learning companion AI who was supposed to be the mascot for the moon's solar farm.

She lives alone in a corner of the moon server known as Lunar world.

[spoiler]In her "real form", Lunar-Q remotely controls an android body to experience what life is like on Earth.[/spoiler]

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2983260/LUNARiA_Virtualized_Moonchild/]Steam[/url]]

[spoiler]Real name: Amamiya Kiyu (天宮 希優)[/spoiler]
